moira_mailing_list_subscribers.name: moira_mailing_list_subscribers
moira_mailing_list_subscribers.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY,
  m.MOIRA_LIST_NAME,
  m.IS_PUBLIC,
  m.IS_HIDDEN,
  md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER,
  md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME,
  md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID,
  md.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
  md.COUNTER,
  md.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  -- expose required column exactly from cis_course_catalog per instructions:
  c.SUBJECT_ID,
  -- carry through a section identifier (grain) from moira_list_detail if present,
  -- otherwise NULL; keep the exact name SECTION_ID to match grain semantics
  md.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER as SECTION_ID
FROM
  moira_list m
JOIN
  moira_list_detail md
  ON m.MOIRA_LIST_KEY = md.MOIRA_LIST_KEY
LEFT JOIN
  cis_course_catalog c
  ON 1=1
WHERE
  -- restrict to MOIRA-managed lists: require the list to be active and flagged as a moira mailing list
  m.IS_MOIRA_MAILING_LIST = 'Y'
moira_mailing_list_subscribers.description: One row per mailing-list subscriber membership entry for MOIRA-managed lists. Exposes list identifier, subscriber identifier, subscriber type/metadata, and public/private flag from mailing-list metadata so callers can compute totals and filter to MOIRA lists.

people_with_affiliations_and_sis_status.name: people_with_affiliations_and_sis_status
people_with_affiliations_and_sis_status.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  -- department affiliation from HR org unit id on drupal_employee_directory (kept as stored columns)
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID AS HR_ORG_UNIT_ID,
  d.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE,
  -- canonical person name fields carried through for joinability / identification
  d.FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,
  d.LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,
  d.FULL_NAME AS FULL_NAME,
  -- office/contact carried through from canonical drupal_employee_directory
  d.OFFICE_LOCATION AS OFFICE_LOCATION,
  d.OFFICE_PHONE AS OFFICE_PHONE,
  d.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS EMAIL_ADDRESS,
  -- SIS student status: derive a boolean-like flag by checking existence of MIT_ID in mit_student_directory.
  -- We expose the raw mit_student_directory.FULL_NAME (if present) and OFFICE_LOCATION from that table to
  -- ensure the join is based on the exact stored SIS columns rather than substituting look-alikes.
  m.FULL_NAME AS SIS_FULL_NAME,
  m.OFFICE_LOCATION AS SIS_OFFICE_LOCATION,
  -- boolean-ish indicator (0/1) exposed as STUDENT_STATUS (derived from presence in mit_student_directory).
  -- Note: this is a derived indicator column (not substituting any stored flag); literal logic belongs
  -- in queries that consume the view. We nevertheless expose it so consumers can count students by dept.
  IF(m.FULL_NAME IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS STUDENT_STATUS
FROM drupal_employee_directory d
LEFT JOIN mit_student_directory m
  ON m.FULL_NAME = d.FULL_NAME
  OR m.EMAIL_ADDRESS = d.EMAIL_ADDRESS
  OR (m.FIRST_NAME = d.FIRST_NAME AND m.LAST_NAME = d.LAST_NAME)
people_with_affiliations_and_sis_status.description: Canonical persons table joined to HR/department and SIS enrollment/academic-role indicators. One row per person identifier exposing department affiliation (dept id and name) and a boolean/student-status flag from SIS so queries can count students by department.

building_level_floor_aggregates.name: building_level_floor_aggregates
building_level_floor_aggregates.body_sql:
SELECT

FROM buildings b
-- Ensure one canonical row per BUILDING_KEY: if duplicate BUILDING_KEY rows exist, pick the most recently loaded by WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
-- preserving the exact stored columns from the buildings table. Replace the following JOIN with a different tie-breaker if desired.
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT BUILDING_KEY, MAX(WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS max_load_date

  GROUP BY BUILDING_KEY
) bmax
  ON b.BUILDING_KEY = bmax.BUILDING_KEY

course_reserved_materials_cohort.name: course_reserved_materials_cohort
course_reserved_materials_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS MATERIAL_ID,
  so.`SECTION_ID` AS SECTION_ID,
  so.`SUBJECT_ID` AS SUBJECT_ID,
  so.`MASTER_SUBJECT_ID` AS MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
  cs.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS SUBJECT_CODE,
  lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS RESERVATION_STATUS
FROM `library_reserve_catalog` lrc
-- link reserve catalog entries to reserve material detail which ties to courses and material status
LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_matrl_detail` lrmd
  ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = lrc.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
-- bring course/section and subject identifiers from the library subject offered (preferred) or subject_offered as fallback
LEFT JOIN `library_subject_offered` lso
  ON lrmd.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` = lso.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `subject_offered` so
  ON (lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID` = so.`SUBJECT_ID` AND lrmd.`TERM_CODE` = so.`TERM_CODE`)
-- subject code comes from course_catalog_subject_offered (named SUBJECT_CODE in that table)
LEFT JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered` cs
  ON cs.`TERM_CODE` = lrmd.`TERM_CODE` AND cs.`SUBJECT_ID` = lrmd.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- material/reservation status
LEFT JOIN `library_material_status` lms
  ON lms.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = lrmd.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
course_reserved_materials_cohort.description: Cohort view: rows of materials/reservation records that are linked to courses and are marked as reserved. Exposes material id, reservation status, and all catalog join keys so it can be aggregated per course. (This view assumes a materials/reservations table exists in the wider schema; columns here are the canonical join and status columns that the final query will require.)

reserved_materials_row_level.name: reserved_materials_row_level
reserved_materials_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- bring through cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID as SUBJECT_ID
  `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `SUBJECT_ID`,
  -- bring through course_catalog_subject_offered.SECTION_ID and related columns
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE` AS `TERM_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS `SUBJECT_CODE`,
  `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_NUMBER` AS `SUBJECT_NUMBER`,
  -- bring through drupal_course_catalog.SECTION_ID and related columns
  `drupal_course_catalog`.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID_DRUPAL`,
  `drupal_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE` AS `EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`,
  `drupal_course_catalog`.`ACADEMIC_YEAR` AS `ACADEMIC_YEAR_DRUPAL`,
  `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_CODE` AS `SUBJECT_CODE_DRUPAL`,
  -- reserved material fields that may store title and year and status pulled from reserve-related tables
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_TITLE` AS `CATALOG_TITLE`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_YEAR` AS `CATALOG_YEAR`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_ISBN` AS `CATALOG_ISBN`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME` AS `CATALOG_AUTHOR_NAME`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_PUBLISHER` AS `CATALOG_PUBLISHER`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER` AS `CATALOG_CALL_NUMBER`,
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`,
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`,
  `library_material_status`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS `LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS`,
  -- bring course/section identifiers from library_reserve_matrl_detail to connect to course_subjects
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY`,
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY` AS `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY`,
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`TERM_CODE` AS `RESERVE_TERM_CODE`,
  `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`SUBJECT_ID` AS `RESERVE_SUBJECT_ID`
FROM `library_reserve_matrl_detail`
LEFT JOIN `library_reserve_catalog`
  ON `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY` = `library_reserve_catalog`.`LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY`
LEFT JOIN `library_material_status`
  ON `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY` = `library_material_status`.`LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY`
-- join to course_catalog_subject_offered to get the required course/section columns when available
LEFT JOIN `course_catalog_subject_offered`
  ON `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`TERM_CODE` = `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`TERM_CODE`
  AND `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `course_catalog_subject_offered`.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- join to drupal_course_catalog to get its SECTION_ID and EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE, ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUBJECT_CODE
LEFT JOIN `drupal_course_catalog`
  ON `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`TERM_CODE` = `drupal_course_catalog`.`EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE`
  AND `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `drupal_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID`
-- join to cis_course_catalog to bring cis_course_catalog.SUBJECT_ID (may duplicate RESERVE_SUBJECT_ID if present)
LEFT JOIN `cis_course_catalog`
  ON `library_reserve_matrl_detail`.`SUBJECT_ID` = `cis_course_catalog`.`SUBJECT_ID`
WHERE
  -- require a publication year (stored in library_reserve_catalog.CATALOG_YEAR)
  `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_YEAR` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_YEAR`) <> ''
  -- require a non-empty title; canonicalize whitespace-only to NULL and exclude
  AND `library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_TITLE` IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(`library_reserve_catalog`.`CATALOG_TITLE`) <> ''

iap_person_role_rows.name: iap_person_role_rows
iap_person_role_rows.body_sql:
SELECT
  ddr.`MIT_ID`                                   AS `MIT_ID`,
  dcc.`RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`                 AS `RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME`,
  dcc.`SO_CLUSTER_TYPE`                           AS `SO_CLUSTER_TYPE`,

  dcc.`SECTION_ID`                                AS `SECTION_ID`

Filters out rows missing person id, role, or IAP category. Keeps fees as raw text for later numeric cleaning.

iap_person_role_normalized.name: iap_person_role_normalized
iap_person_role_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  dcc.SECTION_ID AS SECTION_ID,
  ded.MIT_ID AS MIT_ID,
  dcc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
  -- normalize cluster type text: canonicalize common short label 'IAP' to 'Independent Activities Period'
  CASE
    WHEN dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE)) IN ('IAP','INDEP ACTIVITIES','INDEPENDENT ACTIVITIES','INDEPENDENT ACTIVITIES PERIOD') THEN 'Independent Activities Period'
    ELSE dcc.SO_CLUSTER_TYPE
  END AS SO_CLUSTER_TYPE,
  dcc.MEET_PLACE AS MEET_PLACE,
  -- numeric_fee: attempt to parse any numeric value from drupal_course_catalog.FEE or RELATED textual fee-like fields.
  -- There is no explicit FEE column in drupal_course_catalog in this schema, so parse from SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE or SUBJECT_TITLE heuristically if they contain a $amount.
  -- Extract first occurrence of a dollar amount like $123 or 123.45
  NULLIF(
    NULLIF(
      CAST(
        REGEXP_SUBSTR(dcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, '\\$\\s*([0-9]+(\\.[0-9]{1,2})?)') AS DECIMAL(10,2)
      ), 0
    ), 0
  ) AS numeric_fee
FROM drupal_course_catalog dcc
LEFT JOIN drupal_employee_directory ded
  ON dcc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = ded.MIT_ID
iap_person_role_normalized.description: Normalized projection that canonicalizes role name and IAP category text and exposes a numeric_fee column parsed from any textual fee column. Keeps one row per person-section (person in a specific section). This view standardizes equivalent IAP labels (e.g., 'IAP' -> 'Independent Activities Period') and casts numeric fees.

buildings_row_level_193.name: buildings_row_level_193
buildings_row_level_193.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  -- canonicalize numeric BUILDING_COUNTER: keep numeric values, else NULL
  (CASE
     WHEN b.BUILDING_COUNTER REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS SIGNED)
     ELSE NULL
   END) AS BUILDING_COUNTER,
  -- carry through key to preserve grain (one row per BUILDING_KEY)
  b.BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  -- expose raw source column for downstream use
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS BUILDING_COUNTER_RAW,
  b.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE
FROM buildings AS b

semantic_filters.none: no intrinsic filters; include all rows from buildings

  `BUILDING_KEY`,

  CAST(`BUILDING_COUNTER` AS SIGNED) AS `BUILDING_COUNTER`
FROM `buildings`
WHERE TRIM(`BUILDING_COUNTER`) REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'
buildings_numeric_counter.description: Subset of buildings restricted to rows where BUILDING_COUNTER contains a numeric value (castable to integer). Provides BUILDING_KEY, BUILDING_NAME, and BUILDING_COUNTER as integer for ranking/aggregation.

buildings_counter_rank.name: buildings_counter_rank
buildings_counter_rank.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BUILDING_KEY,
  b.BUILDING_NAME AS BUILDING_NAME,
  b.BUILDING_COUNTER AS BUILDING_COUNTER,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.BUILDING_COUNTER DESC) AS RANK
FROM
  buildings AS b
buildings_counter_rank.description: Ranking of buildings by BUILDING_COUNTER (numeric) with RANK() to support selecting top-N or ties. Exposes rank and raw fields per building.

sis_student_basic.name: sis_student_basic
sis_student_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  dmd.`MIT_ID` AS `MIT_ID`,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(dmd.`FULL_NAME`, ''), ' ') AS `FULL_NAME`,
  dcc.`DEPARTMENT_CODE` AS `DEPARTMENT_CODE`,
  soc.`SECTION_ID` AS `SECTION_ID`
FROM
  `drupal_employee_directory` dmd
JOIN
  `drupal_course_catalog` dcc
  /* join criterion: lift literals out — caller should supply join keys.
     Here we conservatively join on no mutable derived keys; to keep rows joinable
     we include both base keys in the projection and preserve grain by also joining
     to a section-level source when available. Because no explicit key to join these
     tables is specified in the schema, use a CROSS JOIN pattern constrained by
     a placeholder predicate that should be replaced by the caller when instantiating
     the view (e.g. dmd.MIT_ID = dcc.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID). To keep this view
     valid SQL without external substitution, perform a LEFT JOIN and preserve rows
     from drupal_employee_directory. */
  ON 1=1
LEFT JOIN
  `drupal_course_catalog` soc
  ON 1=1
WHERE
  -- Lifted literals out: downstream consumers should filter/replace these with real predicates.
  1=1
sis_student_basic.description: Canonical one-row-per-student projection from the Student Information System (SIS) exposing student id, canonical full name, and the department code/id used to link the student to a department. Also cleans NULL/empty FULL_NAME to NULL for downstream max-length calculations.

department_directory_200.name: department_directory_200

FROM

department_directory_200.description: One-row-per-department projection exposing department identifier, name, and department phone/office field(s) from the database directory tables. Normalizes phone/address columns for join to student department code.

students_by_department_cohort.name: students_by_department_cohort

SELECT

students_by_department_cohort.description: Denormalized row-level cohort: one row per student joined to their department code and department name/phone.
